archetypes.name: collector-contract
archetypes.rationale: Collector output grammar and retry edge cases are high-risk compatibility surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/collect_results.py against the retired shell collector contract. Focus on stdout block order, status and exit-code mappings, retry metadata fail-closed behavior, and validation sequencing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: caller-cutover
archetypes.rationale: Multiple runtime and docs callers moved from a shell path to the Python CLI.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit every changed caller and structure pin that invokes the collector. Verify argv, quiet stderr routing, paths-file behavior, and fallback logging still match each skill surface. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retirement-hygiene
archetypes.rationale: The change deletes a large shell surface and retires harness paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the deleted collector scripts, migrated-scripts.tsv entries, Makefile targets, agent-lint excludes, and docs for stale or contradictory references. Pay special attention to test coverage lost during shell harness retirement. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
